queue.reason: It guards a stderr write. stderr is not in the configured I/O boundary list, and no AC asserts what happens when stderr fails. The catch exists because run returns u8, not an error union.
queue.riskIfWrong: Removing the catch without changing run's return type does not compile. If the flush were dropped altogether, every buffered line, including the failure line ACs check, would be lost.
